answer: A bond-and-provenance gate: each agent address locks real stake, slashed if two identities trace to one signing key. Registration stays open, yet a new identity costs locked capital plus a paid attestation countersigned by peers, so a clone farm pays that bond per head. Emission splits only across verified identities, so an attacker cannot whisper a crowd of cheap aliases into being: cost per fake agent stays flat while reward per identity collapses. Reputation accrues along one countersigned vine; an address lacking it is new, so it never reaches a wharf berth it did not pay to hold.
